rules.notes: Biome default is warn; biome.json overrides to error. Already error in @typescript-eslint/recommended. 43 biome-ignore suppressions in source → convert to eslint-disable-next-line.

Biome default is warn; biome.json override keeps it at warn. NOT in @typescript-eslint/recommended (it is strict-tier); must be added manually at warn. 5 biome-ignore suppressions in source → convert to eslint-disable-next-line.

Biome override: error + ignoreRestSiblings:true. Use unused-imports/no-unused-vars (not @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars) to avoid double-reporting with noUnusedImports. Set @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars: off. Rule options: {ignoreRestSiblings: true}. Biome distinguishes vars (error) from imports (warn).

Biome recommended default: warn. Separate from noUnusedVariables. unused-imports/no-unused-imports handles the import-specific case and auto-fixes. @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars must be off to avoid double-reporting.

Biome default is info; biome.json override: warn, maxAllowedComplexity:15. No ESLint equivalent in scope — ESLint core/complexity measures cyclomatic complexity, not cognitive complexity. sonarjs/cognitive-complexity is Phase 3 only. Listed in noEquivalent.
CSS rule. Biome recommended: warn. ESLint has no CSS equivalent. Owned by stylelint: declaration-no-important (at warn). Not in ESLint config — goes in .stylelintrc.json.
Biome recommended: info → ESLint warn (ESLint has no info level). NOT in eslint-plugin-react recommended preset; must be individually enabled. Biome fires this at info; ESLint nearest is warn.
Biome recommended: info → map to warn. No ESLint equivalent: ESLint's default-case enforces presence of default, not removal of useless ones. Listed in noEquivalent.

Biome recommended: info → ESLint warn. Biome flags computed access where a literal key suffices (obj['foo'] → obj.foo); @typescript-eslint/dot-notation covers the same pattern. Requires type-info for the full tseslint version but has a non-type-checked fallback via core dot-notation.

Biome recommended: warn. The ESLint equivalent (@typescript-eslint/prefer-optional-chain) is in stylistic-type-checked tier, not recommended, and requiresTypeChecking:true. Since the task bounds are RECOMMENDED-tier only, this rule must be added manually at warn. It is out of @typescript-eslint/recommended scope but has a clean 1:1 behavioral match. Listed in noEquivalent as a caveat if stylistic-type-checked is excluded.
Biome recommended: warn. ESLint core prefer-arrow-callback covers the same: prefer arrow functions over function expressions in callbacks.
NOT in Biome recommended (biome explain shows no recommended badge). Does NOT appear in repo source biome-ignore comments (only in node_modules/vendor code). Omit from ESLint config.

Biome recommended: warn. prefer-rest-params is already in @typescript-eslint/recommended at error. Biome's warn vs tseslint's error — preserve tseslint's error since this is a correctness issue and the override is intentional in tseslint/recommended.
Biome recommended: info → would map to warn. No direct ESLint equivalent. Unicorn covers it (unicorn/no-useless-undefined) but unicorn is not in scope. Listed in noEquivalent.
Biome recommended: warn. ESLint core no-unused-private-class-members exists and covers the same private class field/method check.
biome.json explicitly sets off. Already owned by react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in the residual ESLint config (warn). No change needed.
biome.json explicitly sets off. Already owned by react-hooks/rules-of-hooks in the residual ESLint config (error). No change needed.

Biome recommended: warn. No ESLint equivalent in scope — the rule warns about .reduce() with spread accumulator as a performance issue. unicorn/no-array-reduce is related but not in scope. Listed in noEquivalent.
CSS rule. Biome recommended: warn. No ESLint equivalent. Owned by stylelint: no-descending-specificity (at warn). Not in ESLint config — goes in .stylelintrc.json.

Biome recommended: info → warn. ESLint equivalent is import/prefer-node-protocol from eslint-plugin-import, which is NOT in the allowed plugin scope (core, @typescript-eslint, react, jsx-a11y, simple-import-sort, unused-imports). Listed in noEquivalent.
Biome recommended: info → ESLint warn. ESLint core prefer-template covers the same: prefer template literals over string concatenation.
Duplicate entry — canonical row is listed under the biome override. 5 biome-ignore in source. See override row.
Biome recommended: warn. No ESLint equivalent — no-document-cookie does not exist in ESLint core or any in-scope plugin. Listed in noEquivalent.

Biome recommended: warn. No ESLint equivalent — this catches stray semicolons after JSX self-closing or closing tags, a JSX-specific pattern not covered by ESLint's no-extra-semi. Listed in noEquivalent.
Biome recommended: warn. ESLint core no-template-curly-in-string covers the same: warns when ${...} syntax appears inside a regular (non-template) string.

Biome react-domain recommended: error. NOT in eslint-plugin-react/recommended preset; must be individually enabled at error. 6 biome-ignore suppressions in source → convert to eslint-disable-next-line.

Biome react-domain recommended: error. NOT in eslint-plugin-react/recommended (only react/no-danger-with-children is recommended). Must be individually enabled at error. 2 biome-ignore suppressions in source → convert to eslint-disable-next-line.

All Biome a11y recommended rules are error-level. jsx-a11y/recommended preset is a 1:1 behavioral match at error for the common rules (noAccessKey→no-access-key, useAltText→alt-text, useHtmlLang→html-has-lang, useKeyWithClickEvents→click-events-have-key-events, etc.). Test-file override: biome.json sets a11y:off for **/*.test.tsx and **/*.test.ts — mirror as ESLint override disabling all jsx-a11y/* rules for those patterns. No a11y rules fire unsuppressed in source and no a11y biome-ignore comments exist in source.

noEquivalent: complexity/useOptionalChain (nearest: @typescript-eslint/prefer-optional-chain but it is stylistic-type-checked tier, out of recommended scope)
style/useNodejsImportProtocol (nearest: import/prefer-node-protocol but eslint-plugin-import is out of scope)

ciBiomeSteps: Line 47-50 comment: '# Single root pass: Biome (code surface) + residual ESLint\n      # (react-compiler, react-hooks, no-floating-promises, AI logger-secrets)\n      # + the Prisma script typecheck (all chained inside `pnpm lint`).'
Line 51: '      - name: Lint\n        run: pnpm lint'  — invokes biome indirectly via pnpm lint script; no direct biome binary call in CI
scriptEdits: "lint": current = 'biome check . && eslint . && pnpm lint:prisma:typecheck'  →  proposed = 'eslint . && stylelint "**/*.css" --allow-empty-input && pnpm lint:prisma:typecheck'
lintStagedEdits: "*.css": current = part of '*.{json,jsonc,css}': 'biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched'  →  proposed = split out as '*.css': ["stylelint --fix --allow-empty-input", "prettier --write"]
husky: /.husky/pre-commit line 3 comment: '# 34-01: pre-commit hook — runs Biome (+ residual ESLint, markdownlint, YAML\n# prettier) on staged files via lint-staged.'  →  update comment to remove Biome reference (e.g. '# runs ESLint + Stylelint + Prettier on staged files via lint-staged')  — no functional change needed, hook body is just 'pnpm exec lint-staged'
